title: Determine required security scanner for this repo
description:
The data here is a clone of data from the Connect repo so all fixes would have to occur there.

Should this repo also be running security scans?

Dependabot or Synk? It appears Dependabot is currently enabled here and is generating PR.

title: Add linting the ensure new bundles include expected_result.txt and manifest.json
description:
